name: Alkemy Capital Investments Plc
summary: Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, Alkemy Capital Investments Plc, through its subsidiary Tees Valley Lithium Limited, specializes in the comprehensive development and operation of a plant dedicated to manufacturing lithium hydroxide monohydrate. This essential product is supplied to the expanding mobile energy industries throughout the United Kingdom and continental Europe. The company was previously known as Alkemy Capital Plc before officially changing its name to Alkemy Capital Investments Plc in February 2021.
